chunks: Ali ibn Muhammad, from Sahl ibn Ziyad, from Muhammad ibn al-Rayyan, who said:

I wrote to the Man (peace be upon him): Does the blood of the cow follow the same ruling as the blood of the fleas, and is it permissible for anyone to analogize the blood of the cow to the fleas, so he prays in it, and to analogize in this manner and act upon it? So he (peace be upon him) signed: Prayer is permissible, and purification from it is superior.
ai.seo_question: What is the ruling on praying in clothing stained with cow blood compared to flea blood?
ai.summary: In this hadith from *Al-Kafi*, the Imam clarifies the jurisprudential status of cow blood (*dam al-baq*) by comparing it to the blood of fleas (*al-baraghis*), which is generally considered minor impurity (*najis al-awlah*). The Imam confirms that one may analogize the ruling of cow blood to that of fleas for the purpose of prayer, noting that while purification is permissible, it is superior (*afdal*) to be thorough. This reflects the Shia scholarly approach to distinguishing between major and minor impurities based on textual evidence and analogical reasoning (*qiyas*) in practical worship.

en.hubeali: Ali Bin Muhammad, from Sahl Bin Ziyad, from Muhammad Bin Al rayyan who said,

‘I wrote to the manasws, ‘Would (the same Law) flow for the blood of the bugs what flows for the blood of the fleas, and it is allowed for anyone that he analogises by the blood of the bugs upon the fleas, so he prays Salaat in it, and if he does analogise upon the approximate of this, so can he act upon it?’ So heasws signed: ‘The Salaat is allowed, and the purification from it is superior’.
en.sarwar: 9. Ali ibn Muhammad has narrated from Sahl ibn Ziyad from Muhammad ibn al-Rayyan who has said the following: “

I once wrote to the man, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, asking, ‘Is the blood of bugs like the blood of fleas? Is it permissible for one to consider blood of bugs like that of fleas, perform Salah (prayer) with it and analogize to act upon such analogy?’ He (the Imam) wrote with his signature, ‘It is permissible to perform Salah (prayer) with it, but washing is better.’”
